cards.text: Big news, friend: David has been anointed king over Israel. Then the Philistines, a neighboring nation, hear about it. And let me tell you, they are NOT sending a congratulations card.

cards.question: When the Philistines hear that David has been anointed king over Israel, what do they do?

answers.text: They all go in search of him
They pull back to their own land
They wait to see what he does

cards.question: David learns the Philistines are searching for him, so he goes down to the ___.

cards.text: Meanwhile, the Philistines come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim. Not sneaking, not hiding, just spread out like they own the WHOLE valley.

cards.question: With the Philistines spread out in the Valley of Rephaim, what does David do?

answers.text: He asks the LORD what to do
He sends out a few spies

cards.text: David asks the LORD straight out, “Should I go up against the Philistines? Will You deliver them into my hand?” No small talk, friend. Two questions, and then he WAITS for the answer.

cards.question: The LORD tells David to stay in the stronghold and let the Philistines leave on their own.

cards.text: Nope! The LORD says, “Go up,” and promises He will surely deliver the Philistines into David's hand. So David goes to Baal-perazim, and he defeats them there.

cards.question: After the battle at Baal-perazim, David says it was like a bursting flood: the ___ burst out against his enemies before him.

cards.text: So David names that place Baal-perazim. Me, I got my name carved into a handle, and this man is out here naming the MAP.

cards.question: At Baal-perazim, the Philistines abandon their idols, and David and his men leave the idols right where they lie.

cards.text: Nope, David and his men carry those idols away. Then once again the Philistines come up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim, like a snooze alarm: you hit it once, and BEEP BEEP BEEP, it's back.

cards.question: Same enemy, same valley. So this time David skips asking the LORD and just repeats what worked before.
David asks the LORD again, and this time the plan is different. What does the LORD tell him to do?

cards.text: No marching straight up this time. The LORD tells David to circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees.

cards.question: David is to wait by the balsam trees behind the Philistines. What's his signal to move?

answers.text: The sound of marching in the treetops
A trumpet blast from the hills
A loud shout from the camp

cards.text: Marching. In the TOPS of the trees. When David hears it, he's told to move quickly. Me? I waited YEARS for a junk drawer to rattle open, and this man gets a signal from the TREES.

cards.question: What will the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees mean for David?

answers.text: The LORD has gone out before him
The Philistines are ready to retreat
His own men are all in place

cards.question: The plan is set, and David does as the LORD commanded him.
David strikes down the Philistines all the way from ___ to ___.
